name.description: Name of the network admin or team.

database.description: Database backend configuration (e.g., SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL).

params.description: Key-value parameters for the database module.

defaults.description: Default limits applied to new users and channels.

max_channels_per_user.description: Maximum channels a user may be opered in (used by some services).

max_chans.description: Maximum channels a user may register.

max_nicks.description: Maximum nicknames a user may register (typically 1).

modules.load.description: List of core Anope modules to load.

opers.description: List of service operators (opers) with elevated privileges.

nick.description: Required nickname (if set, user must be using this nick to login).

password.description: Plain-text password (recommended to use hashed password in production).

vhost.description: Virtual hostname to assign upon login (e.g., opers@example.com).

log_snoops.description: Log user actions (e.g., nick changes, messages) to oper snoop channels.

send_core_dump.description: Send crash/core dump notifications to opers.

send_oper_notice.description: Send operational messages (e.g., module load errors) to opers.

server.description: Connection settings for the upstream IRC daemon (e.g., UnrealIRCd, InspIRCd).

hostname.description: IP address or hostname of the IRC server to connect to.

name.description: Server name (must be unique and match servername in IRCd config).

password.description: Link password (shared secret) between Anope and the IRCd.

port.description: Port number on which the IRC server listens for services links.

ssl.description: Enable SSL/TLS for the link to the IRC server.

ssl_ca.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for verifying server cert (optional).

ssl_cert.description: Path to SSL certificate file (required if ssl=true).

ssl_key.description: Path to SSL private key file (required if ssl=true).

servicename.description: The name of the services server (must be DNS-resolvable and match what the IRCd expects).

connection_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for connection to succeed before retry.

dead_link_timeout.description: Seconds before a dead link is removed.
